controls.assessment: Foundry owns the one boundary and its isolated local state. The foundation backend is not used. Craig accepted a FileVault state copy and checksummed checkpoint on the same disk for this disposable trial.
coverage_gaps: No boundary exists or state checkpoint is verified. Disk loss can destroy both copies and require reviewed manual inventory/import or cleanup. Application state remains separate from foundation state.

controls.assessment: Stage A targets only the pre-reviewed maximum-permissions boundary through the isolated temporary root session. The trial operator cannot create or edit its own boundary.
coverage_gaps: The live boundary/default version, root source guard, and later effective service-role permissions remain unverified. No trial role or assignment is created in this stage.

controls.assessment: Foundation preflight found an active management root key. The Stage A boundary uses the isolated login path; no IAM-02 exception was selected, and trial jobs wait for key remediation.
coverage_gaps: This owner relies on the paired aws-setup root retirement evidence. Foundry does not own the credential migration, observation, or deletion.
